cases.prompt: Find dead, duplicated, or speculative LabKit surfaces that can be safely removed from this subsystem.
cases.rationale: Evidence-backed simplification discovery is the Skill's primary purpose.

cases.prompt: Prove whether this compatibility adapter still has a supported consumer, then remove it if obsolete.
cases.rationale: Consumer classification and bounded removal are in scope.

cases.prompt: These developer menus, fixture protocols, docs, and tests only consume one another. Check whether a real product outcome remains and retire the cluster if not.
cases.rationale: Self-maintaining maintenance consumers and uniformity without product demand are core simplification evidence.

cases.prompt: Split every MATLAB file over 300 lines into helpers.
cases.rationale: File length alone is not evidence for an ownership change.

cases.prompt: Rename variables and reorder methods to match my preferred style.
cases.rationale: Style-only cleanup is outside evidence-backed simplification.

cases.prompt: Make every App use the same archive schema even though their continuation workflows differ.
cases.rationale: Uniformity alone is not evidence for a shared product contract.
